title: install.sh
description: Exported by Interlinear 0.1.0 from install.sh. Steps are chained only within each source file, in its line order; the files are parallel lanes, since nothing in them orders one against another. Each step cites its transcript lines and gloss sources.

steps.description: Line 5 (rule; operator): Downloads a file from a remote host to disk.
Line 6 (rule; operator): Makes a file executable, typically a payload that was just downloaded.
Line 7 (rule; operator): Creates or edits a cron job so a command runs on a schedule.
Line 9 (rule; operator): Deletes files that look like intrusion traces (temporary or hidden paths, the running script, dropped tools), or shreds files.
